integrity: The analytic saddle proof establishes the asymptotic. A finite quadrature script provides diagnostics only and is not used as an infinite proof. Public-source priority was compared on best accessible evidence.
scientific_limitations: Fixed real positive argument; even differentiation index, evaluated at order zero. The expansion does not claim uniformity as argument varies with index, complete higher-order expansions, or novel general Laplace methodology. Classical implicit priority risk remains.
title: A universal one-twelfth saddle correction for high Macdonald order derivatives
